messages:
kevin: hey team 0 i lost my physical insurance card while traveling and the imaging center says they need proof before doing my scheduled MRI tomorrow. i also need pre-auth on file. can benefits help fast?

zoe-benefits: sorry to hear that @kevin. two quick paths: 1) we can issue a temporary verification letter and fax it to the imaging center; 2) we can request an expedited digital ID from the carrier (some carriers can email a pdf of the member card within hours). did you enroll in the plan this year (so member file active)?

kevin: yes active plan. member id 555-888-777. appointment: Central Imaging, 07/15/2025 9:30am. their scheduling line: 206-555-3344.

imaging-center: Central Imaging here. without a front/back of card or verification we can't start the MRI, and authorization is required for outpatient MRI per carrier rules. if benefits faxes a verification letter with expected auth status we'll accept it and proceed to collect auth number later.

zoe-benefits: ok i'll request expedited digital ID from HealthBridge and also prepare a signed verification letter we can fax. to expedite pre-auth we need the order from your provider (radiology requisition) and the diagnosis code. can you upload the order now?

kevin: uploaded order link: https://files.example/mri-order-0715.pdf. dx: suspected rotator cuff tear (M75.1). physician: Dr. Park.

claims-bot: pre-auth checklist: [Radiology order, diagnosis code, provider NPI, member ID, front/back of card or benefits verification letter]. Typical auth turnaround 1-3 business days; expedited if marked urgent/clinical necessity. If carrier issues auth, provide auth number to imaging center for scheduling.

zoe-benefits: i'll call HealthBridge clinical authorizations now to request expedited prior auth due to lost card and next-day appointment. if they won't expedite, we can ask Central Imaging to hold the slot and pre-register with a deposit; if pre-auth later approves, charge posts.

rita: if we need broker help, flagging our broker contact could push for exception; broker can escalate for clinical urgency. also, get a signed patient attestation from Kevin confirming he lost the card and authorizes release to imaging center.

kevin: i signed and uploaded attestation and a photo ID (driver's license). also forwarded the provider order. thanks.

zoe-benefits: update: carrier can generate temporary e-card PDF within 2 hours and will do an expedited clinical review for auth. i'll fax a verification letter to 206-555-3344 now and cc you. also i'll request expedited auth and ask for a callback.

claims-bot: sample verification letter content to imaging center we will fax: "Redwood Benefits verifies member Kevin R., DOB 1990-02-10, Member ID 555-888-777 is active. Pending prior auth request submitted on 07/14/2025 for MRI (CPT 73721) for M75.1. Carrier to confirm authorization number. Please accept this verification to hold the appointment. Contact benefits@redwood.com for questions."

imaging-center: fax received, thanks. we'll accept the verification and will hold the 9:30am slot pending auth number. if auth not received by 8am tomorrow, you'll need to sign and pay a $150 deposit which is refundable upon auth.

zoe-benefits: carrier just emailed the e-card PDF (forwarding to you now) and said auth review was flagged urgent; expect callback in 2-4 hours. i'll post the auth number here when we have it.

kevin: got the e-card PDF, printing now. huge help, thank you all. :relieved:

claims-bot: next steps checklist for kevin: bring printed e-card + photo ID tomorrow; ask imaging to record auth number when posted; save receipt if deposit paid. If insurer rejects later, submit appeal with order, EOB, and benefits verification letter.

zoe-benefits: closing loop: if auth posts, i'll notify imaging and cancel deposit requirement. if no auth by 8am we will cover deposit temporarily and recover if insurer denies (we'll escalate to broker). keep this thread for updates.

kevin: will do. appreciate the quick response and covering deposit contingency.
